verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a data/API product (not itself an agent), so an official MCP server axis applies and is documented: docs explicitly describe connecting an AI client to Context.dev tools via MCP (context-dev-docs-13), and a probe confirms a live official MCP endpoint at mcp.context.dev/mcp (context-dev-probe-3). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation of MCP usage and more detail on supported tool scopes via MCP.
